verdict.rationale: Docs show a built-in AI assistant (AI Chats) that can be given specific blocks/notes as context, answers grounded in the user's notes, can summarize, draft, and even propose creates/updates, plus auto-fill properties and image analysis — directly matching the story. Data-scope control is addressed via opt-in AI activation and explicit context selection (pass blocks/notes to a chat) rather than a fine-grained visibility/permission system for AI, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of AI assistant quality (community evidence covers general note-taking, not the AI feature). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the AI assistant, and more granular controls over exactly which notes/spaces the AI can access.
